messages:
alex (release-manager): kicking off rc-2 -> canary now. deploy-bot initiated. pulling release notes + changelog.

deploy-bot: starting pipeline for release=rc-2, image=redwood/platform:2026-03-20-rc2
deploy-bot: SBOM scan: metadata mismatch detected for layer 3 (pkg:transitive-lib@1.2.3) -- provenance missing
deploy-bot: vuln scan: 0 critical, 1 high, 2 medium (transitive-lib) -- gating policy: requires security ack or remediation

maria (eng-release): noted. SBOM mismatch looks like the transitive-lib was rebuilt with a different builder id in the base image. probably an upstream rebuild.

sam (security): @alex @maria can you paste the exact vuln findings? high severity CVE id and package scope matter for approval. if it's a transitive non-exploitable path we can scope. :eyes:

jenna (qa): is this going to block the changewindow? we planned a 2-hour canary for EU region.

alex (release-manager): yes, want to avoid full rollback if possible. options: 1) pin base image to previous digest and resume canary 2) rebuild image with pinned transitive-lib (if quick) 3) timebox for 30m to attempt (2) then rollback if fail. prefer (2) then (1) fallback. need security sign-off to proceed with timebox.

maria (eng-release): quick check of SBOM:
```
pkg:transitive-lib@1.2.3
provenance: missing-signature
vulns: [CVE-2025-4890 (HIGH), CVE-2024-2048 (MEDIUM)]
```
reproducer: `docker build -f Dockerfile.prod --build-arg BASE=redwood/base:2026-03-01 .` shows changed buildid in layer 3.

sam (security): CVE-2025-4890 is high and has a remote exploit in certain config. need to know if our usage surface exposes that. can you grep call sites? if it's transitive for a dev-only path we can accept temporary partial rollout; if it's in runtime path we must block.

maria (eng-release): running quick grep... `rg "transitive-lib::open_stream|crypto_use" --hidden src || true` returns one hit in integration helper used only in onboarding job. not in request path.

jenna (qa): integration helper confirmed. QA run for canary does hit onboarding jobs but not prod traffic.

sam (security): ok that reduces impact. Security policy: for high vuln in transitive non-runtime path we can allow scoped canary (EU-only, 5% traffic) with strict monitoring and automatic rollback on error. pin/rollback required if any regression or if we see pack exploit indicators. I can greenlight this if we set the following:
- timebox 2h for canary
- alerting on spike in error/latency and abnormal outbound connections
- must update release notes and incident contact info

alex (release-manager): propose: start EU canary at 5% for 2h, concurrent attempt to rebuild with pinned transitive-lib (maria) within first 30m. if pinned rebuild succeeds, promote and expand. if not, rollback to previous digest pinned to redwood/platform@sha256:8f7a...

maria (eng-release): copying build command now, doing quick pin attempt. ETA 18m.

jenna (qa): I'll update release notes: add note about SBOM mismatch + security-approved scoped canary. add contact: @sam, @alex, oncall link.

sam (security): +1 for scoped canary. I will be monitoring. if Maria's rebuild fails we perform immediate rollback. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: action: start_canary(region=eu,percent=5,release=rc-2) -- started at ts=1738501242

maria (eng-release): rebuild with pinned dep attempted. build logs: `RUNNING -> pin transitive-lib@1.2.2` then `SUCCESS image=redwood/platform:2026-03-20-rc2-pin1`

maria (eng-release): pushed pinned image and triggered canary job for pinned image as a parallel rollout.

alex (release-manager): good work. plan: promote pinned build if canary passes in 2h, otherwise roll back to previous digest. keeping full rollout paused.

deploy-bot: monitor hook registered: alerts -> #incidents and SMS oncall if error_rate > 3x baseline or unexpected egress seen.

sam (security): saw the pinned image CVE scan: CVE-2025-4890 not present, CVE-2024-2048 patched. green on pinned.

jenna (qa): note added to release notes and PR description. tagging release docs.

alex (release-manager): thanks all. leaving this thread open until canary ends (2h). will update final decision.

deploy-bot: canary started for pinned build at ts=1738501248

jenna (qa): running smoke checks against pinned canary, no failures so far.

sam (security): monitoring looks clean for initial 30m. continuing watch. :ok_hand:
